records.text: The Robinson family-heirloom gun takes special bullets, and there was no way the prosecution would be able to connect the bullets to that gun.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep UYkXV9mYbT4)

appearances.snippet: But the reality is, as my source who's close to the Robinson family told me, that that family heirloom gun takes special bullets. ... In fact, I was told that there was no way the prosecution was going to be able to connect the bullets to that gun.

verification.notes: The statement is attributed to an anonymous source close to the Robinson family. Current court reporting confirms that bullet-to-rifle comparison was inconclusive, but no authoritative source found establishes that the heirloom rifle requires special bullets or that connection was impossible. An inconclusive comparison does not prove impossibility.

records.text: And at first they pivoted, but it was sloppy. They had 24 hours. Andrew (Andrew Kolvet) tweeted that they found the bullet. But the reality is, as my source who's close to the Robinson family told me, that that family heirloom gun takes special bullets.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
